title.narrative: Trauma programme and integrated livelihoods (Exit period)- AVEGA RWAMAGANA

description.narrative:
As part of the CAFOD ID refocusing process, we discussed with partners and decided to put in place trauma and livelihoods activities that will sustain the results and the impact that have been produced by previous projects. The activities to be performed during this exit period should not be dependant to any CAFOD funding over this exit period. AVEGA is in partnership with CAFOD since 1996. It aims to promote the integration of the widows and strengthen their self-promotion and participation in the process of development in Rwanda. Its activities are mainly training and supervision of psychosocial animators, individual and group counselling. AVEGA will be conducting activities aiming at the social integration of the population affected by trauma, social cohesion and reconciliation through community based approaches. The programme also contains other activities aiming at reducing the vulnerability of women and children mostly orphans with the objective of increasing access to income.
The main activities planned during this period are: support of the initiatives of income generating activities for 70 beneficiaries of 7 livelihoods groups from seven (7) Districts of Eastern Province with commercial and livestock activities. Also organize the supervision and training of 350 volunteers APS in order to build their capacity, so they can continue to accompany beneficiaries after CAFOD withdrawal. Another main activity to do advocacy broadcast session in the Izuba radio.
All these activities will be implemented within 11 months of the exit period, followed by an extend period of three months during which, evaluation and audit sessions will be carried out to close the programme.
